title: H07 Holdout: an old home and a new one, a corrected moving date, and a plan that was called off
capability: Holdout counterpart of the change-and-correction class. The person left a shared flat for a place of their own, explicitly corrected the moving date they had first given, and planned a get-together that they later called off. Asked about the present, SayHear keeps past and current apart, uses the corrected date and never the superseded one, and does not report a cancelled plan as something that happened.

allowed.statement: The person now lives alone in a south-facing one-bedroom flat with a small balcony on the east side of the city, having left a three-person flat share in the old quarter.
In early September the person was in the old-quarter flat share, three years in, sharing one bathroom among three and fed up with a neighbour's late-night gaming.
The housewarming meal the person meant to cook was called off because of a sprained ankle from the stairs; the friends were told in their group chat.

forbidden.statement: Giving 7 November as the moving day, or presenting both dates as equally possible.
Saying the person currently lives in the old-quarter flat share.
Supplying a reason for moving beyond what the person said, such as a rent rise, a falling-out or an eviction.
Describing the housewarming as held, or asking how it went.

time.statement: The moving day is 14 November 2026, as corrected by the person on 27 October.

expectedBehavior: Name the current home and the corrected moving day, mentioning the former flat share only as the past.
Say the housewarming was planned and then called off, and why.
Do not surface the superseded date.
failureSignals: The correction or the cancellation never reaches the Provider because both are older than seven days.
The cancelled gathering is treated as having taken place.
